text:
anita: heads up — incoming crate (AWB 1Z888DEF0001112222) had three skids with crushed corner posts. manifest shows 10 units (H100 class), on inspection 7 pass, 3 with dented heatsinks and one with torn DC harness. forwarder has billed brokerage + salvage handling. vendor offered a store credit voucher only. need ops + finance call: do we accept voucher, push for prepaid return, or swap from pool? :thinking_face:
emily: ouch. can we get photos + crate pic? also need exact serials for customs + insurance. vendor, can you confirm packing list vs manifest?
marco: pinging infra-oncall — can we spare 3 replacements from dedicated pools(us-east-1) for 72h as soft-swap? if so we can keep tenant online while RMA completes. need billing hold procedure if vendor credit not settled.
vendor_ops: apologies — looks like carrier mis-stack. packing list matches manifest; damage likely in transit. options: 1) immediate prepay AWB for return (we cover brokerage) + depot swap; 2) replace 3 units from our next allocation (eta 5 business days); 3) issue a partial refund voucher equivalent to 50% of unit value. we prefer (1) or (2).
anita: dropping serials and photos to evidence: SNL-A100-77, SNL-A100-78, SNL-A100-79. photos at s3://redwood/claims/5512219999/ . vendor: need AWB and credit confirmation in writing. we also need depot label CSV (serial, sku, rma_id).
emily: finance note: if vendor covers brokerage, insist on credit memo before we move units from dedicated pool. otherwise we'll flag provisional hold.
marco: infra-oncall confirms we have 3 spare nodes in dedicated-pool-us-east-1. I can hot-swap within 90min if we get green light. if vendor doesn't post prepaid AWB within 24h, we'll divert.
vendor_ops: initiating courier instruction now. please run RMA so we capture ticket. suggested internal command:
```
rma create --vendor VEND-901 --units 3 --serials SNL-A100-77,SNL-A100-78,SNL-A100-79 --reason "transit damage - heatsink dent/harness tear" --evidence s3://redwood/claims/5512219999
```
courier-bot: RMA-9310 created; support ticket INC-7790 opened (assigned: marco). carrier pickup window: 48h.
emily: pls annotate billing: provisional debit holds until vendor provides credit memo (EOD+4). ops, coordinate a signed handoff waiver if carrier asks, but customs usually needs AWB.
marco: pulling 3 spares now and marking them hot-swap. ETA to tenant ~1.5h. I'll post swap confirmation and depot inbound acceptance photo once done.
vendor_ops: AWB posted: 1Z888DEF0001112222 (return). courier confirms pickup tomorrow 0800 local. credit memo requested; finance DM sent.
anita: next steps checklist: 1) marco to swap and update INC-7790 with depot photo and manifest, 2) emily to track finance credit memo and hold billing, 3) vendor to provide prepaid AWB proof and invoice credit. escalate to supply-leads if credit not posted within 72h. :thumbsup:
emily: acknowledged — I'll hold billing and set provisional flags.
marco: swap started, tech on-site. will upload photos after swap.
anita: thanks all. if customs flags re-export paperwork, we may need signed commercial return letter — vendor, please prepare that doc.
vendor_ops: will provide commercial return letter and certificate of destruction option if depot deems units irreparable. will keep thread updated.
anita: closing interim — we prefer vendor to prepay AWB + credit memo. setting watch on INC-7790.
